lockFileMaintenance.description: Re-resolves uv.lock so transitive packages pick up upstream fixes that no direct-dependency rule reaches. Not automerged: uv has no package-manager-level release-age gate, so nothing holds back a package published yesterday when the lock file is rebuilt, and a human reads the diff instead.

customManagers.description: Renovate itself, pinned in the workflow step that validates this file.
pnpm, activated by Corepack for the workflow step that validates this file. This repository has no package.json, so no built-in manager reads that version.

packageRules.description: Merge eligible non-major updates after checks pass; keep unrelated dependencies separate. The strict visual regression in CI is what makes this safe: a layout change of a single pixel fails the check and leaves the pull request for a human.

requires-python says which Python versions guideprint supports, not which one to install, so the repository-wide rangeStrategy pin does not fit it. Pinning turned >=3.12 into ==3.14.8, which made uv reject the Python 3.13 that .python-version selects and would make pip refuse guideprint on any other Python. replace keeps the declared range and only rewrites it when a release falls outside it.
